raw_problem.solution_text:
a) 基态波函数空间部分是对称的，对于政色子而言，要求自旋波函数部分必须也是交换对称的，所以它的基态是正氧，而且是二重简并的.如下所示:

$$
\psi_ {1} \left(q _ {i}\right) \psi_ {1} \left(q _ {j}\right) \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} {| \uparrow \uparrow \rangle} \\ {| \uparrow \downarrow \rangle + | \downarrow \uparrow \rangle} \\ {| \downarrow \downarrow \rangle} \end{array} \right. (\text {正 氪})
$$

激发态可以形成正氨(三重态)或仲氢(独态)，因为正氧的空间波函数是对称的，所以正氧的能量要比对应的仲氧的能量高(这显然与试验矛盾，因为电子不是玻色子).如下所示:

$$
\left[ \psi_ {1} \left(q _ {i}\right) \psi_ {2} \left(q _ {j}\right) + \psi_ {1} \left(q _ {j}\right) \psi_ {2} \left(q _ {i}\right) \right] \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} {| \uparrow \uparrow \rangle} \\ {| \uparrow \downarrow \rangle + | \downarrow \uparrow \rangle} \\ {| \downarrow \downarrow \rangle} \end{array} \right. (\text {正 氢})
$$

$$
\left[ \psi_ {1} \left(q _ {i}\right) \psi_ {2} \left(q _ {j}\right) - \psi_ {1} \left(q _ {j}\right) \psi_ {2} \left(q _ {i}\right) \right] \left(\left| \uparrow \downarrow \right\rangle - \left| \downarrow \uparrow \right\rangle\right) \quad (\text {仲 氨})
$$

基态和所有的激发态都能形成正氢和仲氧，而且都是四重简并.但是我们无法事先知道正氧和仲氧的能量哪个高，因为我们不知道这两种态中的哪一个状态将和对称空间披函数相结合.

# 串串习题 5.15

(a) $\psi _ { 0 }$ 态(方程 (5.41))，计算 $\left. ( 1 / | r _ { 1 } - r _ { 2 } | ) \right.$ .提示在极坐标下，首先对$\mathrm { d } ^ { 3 } { \pmb r } _ { 2 }$ 做积分，再令极轴沿 $r _ { 1 }$ 方向，使得

$$
\left| \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} \right| = \sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2} \cos \theta_ {2}}.
$$

对 $\theta _ { 2 }$ 的积分很容易'但要注意根号下只能取正值.你需要把 $r _ { 2 }$ 分为两部分，第一部分积分从 $r _ { 1 }$ ，第二部分积分从 $r _ { 1 }$ 到 $\infty$

(b) 利用 的结果估算氯原子基态的电子相互作用能.结果用电子伏特表示，并加到 $E _ { 0 }$ {方程 (5.42)) 上，得到修正后估算的氨原子基态能量，并与实验值相比较.(当然，使用的仍然是一个近似波函数，所以不要指望两个值完全吻合.)

解答 (a) 波函数

$$
\psi_ {0} = \left(\frac {8}{\pi a ^ {3}}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 (r _ {1} + r _ {2}) / a},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle \frac{1}{|\boldsymbol{r}_{1} - \boldsymbol{r}_{2}|}\right\rangle = \langle \psi_{0}|\frac{1}{|\boldsymbol{r}_{1} - \boldsymbol{r}_{2}|} |\psi_{0}\rangle = \left(\frac{8}{\pi a^{3}}\right)^{2}\int \underbrace{\left[\int\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-4(r_{1} + r_{2}) / a}}{\sqrt{r_{1}^{2} + r_{2}^{2} - 2r_{1}r_{2}\cos\theta_{2}}}\mathrm{d}^{3}\boldsymbol{r}_{2}\right]}_{P}\mathrm{d}^{3}\boldsymbol{r}_{1}. \\ P = \iiint \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 (r _ {1} + r _ {2}) / a}}{\sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2} \cos \theta_ {2}}} r _ {2} ^ {2} \sin \theta_ {2} \mathrm {d} \theta_ {2} \mathrm {d} \varphi \mathrm {d} r _ {2} \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 (r _ {1} + r _ {2}) / a} \underbrace {\left[ \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \frac {\sin \theta_ {2}}{\sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2} \cos \theta_ {2}}} \mathrm {d} \theta_ {2} \right]} _ {Q} r _ {2} ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r _ {2} \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = 2\pi \int_{0}^{\infty}\mathrm{e}^{-4(r_{1} + r_{2}) / a}\underbrace{\left[\int_{0}^{\pi}\frac{\sin\theta_{2}}{\sqrt{r_{1}^{2} + r_{2}^{2} - 2r_{1}r_{2}\cos\theta_{2}}}\mathrm{d}\theta_{2}\right]}_{Q}r_{2}^{2}\mathrm{d}r_{2}. \\ Q = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \frac {- 1}{\sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2} \cos \theta_ {2}}} d (\cos \theta_ {2}) \\ = \frac {1}{- 2 r _ {1} r _ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \frac {- 1}{\sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2} \cos \theta_ {2}}} d (- 2 r _ {1} r \cos \theta_ {2}) \\ = \frac {1}{2 r _ {1} r _ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \frac {1}{\sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2} \cos \theta_ {2}}} d \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r \cos \theta_ {2}\right) \\ = \frac {1}{r _ {1} r _ {2}} \sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2} \cos \theta_ {2}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\pi} \\ = \frac {1}{r _ {1} r _ {2}} \left(\sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} + 2 r _ {1} r _ {2}} - \sqrt {r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 r _ {1} r _ {2}}\right) \\ = \frac {1}{r _ {1} r _ {2}} \left[ (r _ {1} + r _ {2}) - | r _ {1} - r _ {2} | \right] = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2}{r _ {1}} & (r _ {2} <   r _ {1}) \\ \frac {2}{r _ {2}} & (r _ {1} <   r _ {2}) \end{array} \right.. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
P = 4 \pi \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} \left(\frac {1}{r _ {1}} \int_ {0} ^ {r _ {1}} r _ {2} ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} \mathrm {d} r _ {2} + \int_ {r _ {1}} ^ {\infty} r _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} \mathrm {d} r _ {2}\right).
$$

上式中括号中的第一项

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {1}{r _ {1}} \int_ {0} ^ {r _ {1}} r _ {2} ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} \mathrm {d} r _ {2} = \left. \frac {1}{r _ {1}} \left[ - \frac {a}{4} r _ {2} ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} - 2 \left(\frac {a}{4}\right) ^ {2} r _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} - 2 \left(\frac {a}{4}\right) ^ {3} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} \right] \right| _ {0} ^ {r _ {1}} \\ = - \frac {a}{4 r _ {1}} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} + \frac {a}{2} r _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} + \frac {a ^ {2}}{8} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{8}\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

第二项

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {r _ {1}} ^ {\infty} r _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} \mathrm {d} r _ {2} = \left. \left[ - \left(\frac {a}{4}\right) r _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} - \left(\frac {a}{4}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {2} / a} \right] \right| _ {r _ {1}} ^ {\infty} \\ = \frac {a}{4} r _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} + \frac {a ^ {2}}{1 6} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} P = 4 \pi \left[ \frac {a ^ {3}}{3 2 r _ {1}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} + \left(- \frac {a}{4} r _ {1} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{8} - \frac {a ^ {3}}{3 2 r _ {1}} + \frac {a}{4} r _ {1} + \frac {a ^ {2}}{1 6}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8 r _ {1} / a} \right] \\ = \frac {\pi a ^ {2}}{8} \left[ \frac {a}{r _ {1}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} - \left(2 + \frac {a}{r _ {1}}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8 r _ {1} / a} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

因此，

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle \frac {1}{| \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} |} \right\rangle = \frac {8}{\pi a ^ {4}} 4 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \left[ \frac {a}{r _ {1}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} - \left(2 + \frac {a}{r _ {1}}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8 r _ {1} / a} \right] r _ {1} ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r _ {1} \\ = \frac {3 2}{a ^ {4}} \left(a \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 r _ {1} / a} \mathrm {d} r _ {1} - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r _ {1} ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8 r _ {1} / a} \mathrm {d} r _ {1} - a \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 8 r _ {1} / a} \mathrm {d} r _ {1}\right) \\ = \frac {3 2}{a ^ {4}} \left[ a \cdot \left(\frac {a}{4}\right) ^ {2} - 2 \cdot 2 \left(\frac {a}{8}\right) ^ {3} - a \cdot \left(\frac {a}{8}\right) ^ {2} \right] \\ = \frac {3 2}{a} \left(\frac {1}{1 6} - \frac {1}{1 2 8} - \frac {1}{6 4}\right) \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= \frac {5}{4 a}.
$$

..,,

$$
\begin{array}{l} V _ {e e} \approx \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left\langle \frac {1}{| \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} |} \right\rangle = \frac {5}{4} \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{a} = \frac {5}{2} \frac {m}{\hbar^ {2}} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}\right) ^ {2} \\ = \frac {5}{2} (- E _ {1}) = \frac {5}{2} (1 3. 6 \mathrm {e V}) = 3 4 \mathrm {e V}, \\ E _ {0} + V _ {e e} \approx (- 1 0 9 + 3 4) \mathrm {e V} = - 7 5 \mathrm {e V}. \\ \end{array}
$$
